errors.evidence: The description uses the Bulgarian word "съвпадение" (coincidence) to describe the "Alignment" metric. A more accurate translation would be "съответствие" or "съгласуваност" (alignment/consistency), as used in the reference. This misrepresents the metric being measured.

errors.text_span: има лек спад до около 0.51 при популярност 10.0, след което се стабилизира на ниво около 0.52 до популярност 15.0
errors.evidence: This description of the pink "Alignment" line's trend is incorrect. The line does not drop to 0.51 at a question popularity of 10.0; it reaches its local minimum of ~0.51 at a popularity of ~14.5. Furthermore, it does not stabilize at ~0.52 between popularity 10.0 and 15.0; it actually decreases during this interval.

errors.evidence: The green line, representing 'Confidence', starts at a value of approximately 0.57-0.58 on the y-axis, not 0.55. The value 0.55 is closer to the starting point of the red line.

errors.text_span: bleibt dann nahezu konstant bei etwa 0,6 bis 15,0
errors.evidence: The green line, representing 'Confidence', does not remain 'nahezu konstant' (nearly constant) between a popularity of 10.0 and 15.0. It shows a clear, albeit gradual, increase from approximately 0.6 to 0.63 in this range.

Describing the point at a popularity of 6.0 as a 'Gipfel' (peak) is an exaggeration, as the value only increases slightly from ~0.53 to ~0.54, and a similar value is seen at a popularity of 9.0.
